text:
Nora White: FYI noticed a short blip 03:12 UTC where a subset of cross-region requests errored out. Signal: increased tls_sni_mismatch and DNS failovers to standby LB. Affected ~2.5% of requests for ~6m. Opening thread to coordinate follow-ups.
Elias (oncall): Seeing the same. Traces indicate requests from ap-south hitting us, then egress to eu-west hitting an unexpected LB with old SNI config. Created INF-2034.
Priya Kapoor: Can you paste the sample logs/traces? Want to check if it's a config push or stale DNS cache.
Elias (oncall): Sample trace ids -> a1c9f2, a1c9ff. Proxy log excerpt: ```
[2026-03-25T03:12:13Z] lb-proxy: outbound to lb-standby-eu error: tls: bad certificate (received SNI 'old.example.net')
[2026-03-25T03:12:14Z] dns: resolved service -> lb-standby-eu (ttl=60s)
[2026-03-25T03:12:15Z] routing: detected region-mismatch, attempted failover to standby cluster
```
Ben Ortiz: Looks like the standby LB had an older virtual host config with the old SNI name. That should never be reachable for cross-region traffic. How did traffic pick it up?
Nora White: Early hypothesis: a staged DNS replica lag combined with routing policy that allows fallback to standby when latency spikes. That standby still has legacy vhost.
Priya Kapoor: I ran a quick diff of vhost configs across standby fleet and indeed 3 hosts still had legacy SNI. Possibly missed during last deploy.
ci-bot: Deploy job #4591 to lb-standby-eu completed 2026-03-20T22:10Z (status: success).
Priya Kapoor: Weird, job shows success. I suspect the config propagation agent didn't restart on those hosts. Will SSH and inspect.
Elias (oncall): Mitigation: pinned routing policy to prefer primary LB and disabled auto-failover for 10m around 03:20 -> error rate normalized by 03:18.
alert-bot: Pager suppressed for tls_sni_mismatch for 10m by @Elias.
Nora White: Proposed action items: 
- A1: Repair propagation agent on the 3 standby nodes and re-run config deployment (owner: Priya Kapoor, due: 2026-04-01)
- A2: Add a pre-failover validation that checks vhost/SNI parity before routing fallback (owner: Ben Ortiz, due: 2026-03-30)
- A3: Add DNS monitoring for replica lag > 30s and alert (owner: Platform SRE team, triage ticket INF-2035)
- A4: Audit recent deploys to standby pools over last 60 days to find other missed restarts (owner: Nora White, due: 2026-04-05)
Priya Kapoor: Actionable checklist: `ssh lb-node-7 sudo systemctl status config-propagator && sudo systemctl restart config-propagator` then re-deploy config with `deployctl apply --target standby-eu --vhost-check`
Ben Ortiz: For the pre-failover validation I propose the routing controller do a lightweight TLS handshake (SNI only) against candidate fallback LB and verify the server-name matches expected vhost before switching. I'll draft an RFC and PR.
Elias (oncall): Created INF-2035 for DNS replica monitoring; assigned to Platform SRE.
Nora White: Also recommend we add a nightly job that verifies SNI parity across primary/standby sets and fails CI if mismatch found. Could be a simple curl + openssl s_client check.
Priya Kapoor: Confirmed I've remediated the 3 hosts and re-deployed. Ran `openssl s_client -servername example.net -connect lb-standby-eu:443` -> returned correct cert chain. Pushed notes to INF-2034.
Ben Ortiz: Drafted PR for pre-failover SNI check: https://git.internal/r/routing/pulls/128 (WIP). Tests included.
Nora White: Good. tagging owners in INF-2034: Priya (propagator), Ben (pre-failover guard), Nora (audit + recurrence). Please update tickets with any follow-ups.
Elias (oncall): Adding timeline to incident doc and marking mitigated. Will also schedule a retro to check whether standby-deployment process needs stricter guarantees.
Priya Kapoor: Quick notes for postmortem: root cause = propagation agent didn't restart on 3 standby nodes after config deploy -> stale vhost -> SNI mismatch on fallback. Contributing factors = DNS replica TTL/replication lag + permissive fallback routing.
Nora White: Proposed SLO/alert change: if tls_sni_mismatch rate >= 0.5% for >5m -> page oncall and start failover hold.
Ben Ortiz: I'll add unit tests for the handshake check and coordinate with QA for an integration test.
ci-bot: Created INF-2036: nightly-sni-parity-check job.
Nora White: Thanks all. I'll compile the postmortem and action tracker and link here when ready. Leaving this thread open for owners to post status updates. :spiral_notepad:
